text:
```yaml
name: Publish

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      crate:
        description: 'Select the crate to publish'
        required: true
        options:
          - ic-asset
          - icx-asset

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Cache Cargo registry index
        uses: actions/cache@v2
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry/index
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache Cargo home
        uses: actions/cache@v2
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git/db
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-git-

      - name: Install ic-wasm
        run: curl -fsSL https://sdk.dfinity.org/install.sh | bash

      - name: Build and publish crate
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL: "https"
          CARGO_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CRATES_IO_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event.inputs.crate }}" == "ic-asset" ]]; then
            cargo build --package ic-asset --release
            cargo publish --package ic-asset
          elif [[ "${{ github.event.inputs.crate }}" == "icx-asset" ]]; then
            cargo build --package icx-asset --release
            cargo publish --package icx-asset
          fi
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/publish.yml` is designed to handle the release of `ic-asset` and `icx-asset` version 0.28.1. It includes steps to set up the Rust environment, cache dependencies, install necessary tools, and publish the selected crate to crates.io using the provided API token. The workflow can be triggered manually through the GitHub UI by selecting the crate to publish.
